- trend_slope: mean 1.3302, std 1.2241, trend 1.3634 (strongly increasing)

The trends show ac1 increasing strongly (0.2081), trend_slope increasing strongly (1.3634), low_freq_power increasing strongly (0.1888). These are classic early warning signals of approaching a tipping point - increasing autocorrelation, increasing variance, increasing low-frequency power.
